name: me
description: Read your endpoint identity, declaration, and the receive limits available to each front end.

name: declare
description: Patch your own reception declaration. Omitted fields stay unchanged; accept_from replaces the list, including an empty list to clear it.

name: peers
description: List nodes visible to your endpoint, including the node serving this connection.

name: directory
description: List visible open endpoints on a node. Use next_cursor as cursor for another live page; each page is authorized again. The default limit is 100.

name: send
description: Send a non-empty UTF-8 message to one endpoint. Acceptance is durable, not proof of delivery; inspect status for the outcome. An explicit idempotency_key prevents a duplicate resend of identical content.

name: reply
description: Reply to a message you received. The node chooses its original sender as the recipient and checks reply permission.

name: recv
description: Receive a page without acknowledging unread content. wait_s is clamped to the runtime's declared limit, visible in me. Use the page's next.msg and next.part as msg and part to fetch the next piece without wait_s. ack_lease acknowledges a previously read whole page before receiving.

name: ack
description: Acknowledge only message parts you have read. Omit items for the whole page, or name the message_id and part of each visible piece. The result lists exactly what was acknowledged.

name: status
description: Read the delivery states of a message you sent, including any eventual control reply.

name: control
description: Send a control signal to an endpoint. session.create needs a preset and may include an initial non-empty body. Poll status for the eventual reply and created session endpoint.

name: probe
description: Present the separate one-use probe credential to prove this MCP front end can reach the node. This changes probe state and does not use the endpoint credential.
